thread:
rachel: Deploybot finished rollout v4.0.0 -> prod at 2026-08-09T07:04:01Z. APAC-East synthetic heartbeat shows p95 spike to ~230ms, p50 stable. KV and prefill probes green. Anyone oncall to triage?

deploy-bot: rollout v4.0.0 completed (rollout_id=rl-5g9) :rocket:

kofi: I'm watching. grabbing quickcheck now.

meera: FYI I landed a small change to token normalization in this release — could be related to long-context tokenization costs.

kofi: quickcheck output (apac-east, 10m window): p50=45ms, p95=228ms, p99=400ms, error_rate=0.12% (transient timeouts). Command: `./ops/smoketest --probe heartbeat --region apac-east --window 10m --raw`

rachel: low error rate but tail is bad. Options: 1) weight-shift to previous variant in-region, 2) pin to previous variant, 3) full rollback in region. I prefer 1 to keep some sampling. Thoughts?

ton y: +1 for weight-shift. If it's tokenization on long inputs, sampling helps reproduce and confirm. Suggest 85/15 split for 20m.

meera: agree. I'll also run a tokenizer microbench across variants and tag the PR. If variant shows regression we hotfix.

kofi: applying override: `redwood route override --region apac-east --weights v3.9.8=0.85,v4.0.0=0.15 --ttl 20m --reason "postdeploy heartbeat tail increase"`

synth-bot: route override applied by kofi at 2026-08-09T07:08:12Z (TTL 20m). Sampling enabled for v4.0.0

rachel: running expanded synth (long-tail prompts + large ctx) and capture traces. Command: `./ops/smoketest --profile long-tail --region apac-east --duration 12m --out /tmp/smokes/4.0.0-check.json`

kofi: quick 5m after override: p95=150ms, p99=280ms, errors 0.09% — improved but not baseline (~95ms).

meera: tokenizer bench started across variants, full-run will take ~6m. Also enabling debug sampling for 0.5% of requests to get tokenization times in traces.

meera: bench result: v4.0.0 tokenize p95 +32ms vs v3.9.8 on long contexts. Link: https://internal.perf/tokenize/20260809-v4-diff (internal)

rachel: that looks like a real perf regression in tok path. Given impact to p95, we should rollback in-region to v3.9.8 to restore SLOs. Keep global rollout paused.

ton y: executing in-region rollback: `redwood route override --region apac-east --weights v3.9.8=1.0 --ttl 60m --reason "in-region rollback - tokenize perf regression"`

synth-bot: route override applied (apac-east -> v3.9.8=100%) by tony at 2026-08-09T07:18:34Z. TTL 60m.

kofi: post-rollback quickcheck (5m): p95=98ms, p99=140ms, errors 0.02% — looks back to baseline.

rachel: good. Meera please open a perf-regression PR, include tokenizer bench and traces. Update release notes: mark v4.0.0 as paused in APAC-East due to tokenizer perf regression. Notify CS and account teams in case customers saw tail.

meera: opening PR and patch plan (target v4.0.1) now. Will add a regression test to CI to catch tokenize p95 delta >10ms on long contexts.

ton y: leaving monitoring watch for 2h. If no regressions, we can lift the TTL.

rachel: closing thread for now — thank you. Will follow up with postmortem/perf note. :white_check_mark:
